description: Anyone who has a rudimentary understanding of coding preferably python or R. Also some knowledge of statistics is also desired
summary: This is a assistive recommendation tool for farmers that utilizes causal inference and predictive analytics. It makes forecasts of various variables such as and is able to use a white box Structural causal model to show farmers optimal crop rotations for profit and crop yields to do given the farmers conditions and also allows farmers to explore counterfactual simulations of any kind of scenario of their choosing to see what variables affect profits and crop yields, how do those variables affect them and how does their affect change as the input variable values vary. This addresses the challenge of allowing farmers to make more informed decisions about their farming.
details:
Our Causalfarm team created an assistive AI system for farmers.

One of the benefits that it has is that instead of simply providing raw data or analytics and hard to interpret correlations and trends.
